dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline fitted to the trailing edge from the posterior dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphological point with a moderate pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-50 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Continuous convex arc characterizing a prominent melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick-set rostrum extending from the inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Measurable obtuse interior angle at the melon-rostrum transition.

other_distinctive_markers: Cyan/teal bioluminescent-style coloration and high-luminance white patches on the upper flank.
